metadata.description: Claude Code skills for how an agent should work: conduct rules for every session, delegating to subagents and verifying what comes back, reviews, and writing code - secure code included.

plugins.name: paul-base
plugins.description: Working rules that apply in every context - ask before building, simplicity first, surgical changes, verifiable goals, caution beyond the local machine - kept always-on by a SessionStart hook; plus subagent delegation, reviews, voice profiles, work-directory layout, and a Windows troubleshooting method.

plugins.name: paul-dev
plugins.description: How code is written in any language - conventions for Java, TypeScript/Angular, Python and shell, and the ways AI-generated code goes wrong; secure-coding rules with the evidence behind each; and turning unfamiliar code into a storyboard or a method reference you can learn from.
